body.name: \(\mathfrak R_n\)
body.construction: In the experiment \(X_n\mid\mathbb P_{\boldsymbol\vartheta,n}\sim N(\boldsymbol\vartheta,\Sigma_n^{\mathrm{loc}})\), define \(\mathfrak R_n=\{\prod_{\ell=1}^{H_n}[X_{n,\ell}-s_{\mathrm{dir},n,\ell}W^-_{n,\ell},X_{n,\ell}+s_{\mathrm{dir},n,\ell}W^+_{n,\ell}]:W^-_{n,\ell},W^+_{n,\ell}\ge0\text{ are measurable in }(X_n,U)\}\), where \(U\) is independent auxiliary randomization, \(\Sigma_n^{\mathrm{loc}}\) is the direct leading-score covariance common to every \(\boldsymbol\vartheta\in\Theta_n^{\mathrm{loc}}\), and \(W_n^{\max}=\max_{\ell\le H_n}(W^-_{n,\ell}\vee W^+_{n,\ell})\).
